text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was able to clear the 2nd Stage with 
decent results. Clear the next one, and 
she'll finally advance to the Finals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the 2nd Stage concluded, the 
world was buzzing with talk of the U.A.F., 
and social media was overflowing with 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While delighted by the surging public 
interest, Ryoka Tsurugi and Sonon Elfie 
fire themselves up to generate even more 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see who can bring more hype to the 
U.A.F.!" Spurring each other on, the two 
charge full speed ahead toward the 3rd 
Stage.
